evidence.host_context: Pinned saved RedrawPen/endPen execute through actual WorkerTask::Member2 queue Run, RTV1::Update, and native GraphicsObject::UpdateBuffer. Native RTV1::Draw and Renderer GLES GraphicsObject, BlendStateObject, OpenGLShaderProgram, and ParameterBindingImpl methods execute. Host supplies explicit MotionEvent values, an identity-transform ISPSubBitmap callback interface, synthetic EGL context/GLES object handles/status, source-derived uniform reflection, and intercepted GLES imports. After queued Update, host code redirects PC at movePen+0x3b4 to the native epilogue (+0x3e4); at redraw+0x1f5b4 the queue callback returns through a host trampoline. These redirects skip remaining canvas-size/density metadata; they are not native early returns. Draw then uses the resulting RTV1 state.
limits: No Android EGL/GLES driver or device pixels
Shader compile/link success, uniform reflection and locations are host-adapter values; type is derived from pinned captured GLSL
Identity subbitmap transform and bind/unbind are synthetic host inputs
GL import calls are native call arguments, not executed driver state
